target_customer: Engineering teams that want faster container builds, CI runners and software delivery infrastructure
problem: Container image builds and CI jobs are slow on default infrastructure. Depot provides remote builders with persistent caches, then expanded to CI runners, a registry, source control and sandboxes.
business_model: Usage and plan based infrastructure SaaS

founders.name: Kyle Galbraith
founders.background_notes: Staff engineer at Thorn and Era Software per the YC page, for 4.5 years working with his co-founder.

founders.name: Jacob Gillespie
founders.background_notes: Staff engineer at Thorn and Era Software per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Running fast remote BuildKit builders with persistent caches and reliable multi-tenant isolation is standard infrastructure engineering with hard performance and reliability parts.

defensibility.rationale: Build caches and CI integration create mild lock-in, but several vendors sold similar accelerated runners and builders, and GitHub could improve its own.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors such as Blacksmith, Namespace and BuildJet sell similar runner services per vendor material. No acquisition of Depot found; it moved into CI and source control in 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: The founders started building because of their own platform engineering pain with slow builds, per VentureBeat. Depot launched in beta in May 2022 as a bootstrapped project per its seed announcement as relayed in search results.

branding.domain_note: Uses depot.dev, a developer-oriented TLD, not the .com.

identity.visual_style: Light, dark and system themes, customer logos and speed stats
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, short declarative headlines, uppercase calls to action

branding.brand_signature: Speed claims such as 40x faster container builds
branding.community_and_virality: Joined the CNCF as a member per its blog; customer logos include PostHog, PlanetScale and Semgrep per the YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: Developer community presence through blog and customer logos, but the name is a generic word and no mascot or fan evidence was found.

pivots.to: Broader software delivery: CI, registry, source control, sandboxes
pivots.why: Company positions itself for AI agent-era delivery; dating from site and search summaries, approximate

outcome_analysis: Depot is active and has raised a 4.1 million dollar seed in August 2024 and a 10 million dollar Series A in March 2026, both led or backed by Felicis. It grew from a bootstrapped build accelerator into a wider delivery platform with named customers. Competition from runner vendors and GitHub itself remains the main risk.
notes: Search summaries mention an earlier 1.8M dollar seed in July 2023 from YC, Tokyo Black, Kima and Pioneer Fund, and a 125K YC angel round, but the founder post I opened did not state them, so they are unverified and not recorded. Series A date is March 2026 per search results (10 or 11 March disagree); the company's blog post I opened gave no date. Series A is confirmed by the company blog. Competition list empty: only undated or later vendor pages found. Founders' education not found.
